card.name: Words just before an effect or physiology term
card.fires_on: Strongest on "CV" in "may blunt the CV effects" in NSAID warnings. Also fires on "reduce" or "of" in "reduce gastrointestinal motility" or "decreased levels of pain", and on the end of theophylline before "clearance".
